pokedexEntries.ru: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.

pokedexEntries.sa: WAILMER can store water inside its body to transform itself into a ball for bouncing around on the ground. By filling itself up with more water, this POKéMON can elevate the height of its bounces.

pokedexEntries.frlg: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

pokedexEntries.em: While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

pokedexEntries.dpp: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

pokedexEntries.bw: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It eats one ton of food every day. It plays by shooting stored seawater out its blowholes with great force.

pokedexEntries.mo: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

pokedexEntries.us: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

pokedexEntries.um: Due to their memories of when they once lived on land, pods of them will, very rarely, wash up on shore.
